title: Tech Note: 4D View Helper (Source Code, Part I)

historical_commentary.text: 4D View as a distinct companion product has been discontinued and its spreadsheet-area functionality superseded by newer form objects and, for many use cases, by web-based grid components in current 4D applications, so this component-specific reference note is now of mostly historical interest. The general pattern of wrapping array/record-to-UI binding logic into a reusable helper routine remains a sound software engineering practice.
related_updates: 4D View as a standalone product/plug-in has been discontinued in current 4D
Modern 4D applications typically use list box form objects or web-based grids instead of 4D View areas for tabular display
